note: Harness spec 7.4. A floor and never a gate. It is a deny list in the one place 7.1 permits one, and it inherits that shape's failure mode: silent permission on the spelling nobody wrote down. On `claude` and `cursor-agent` the user's own guards catch what this misses. On `agy` nothing does. Do not read this file as coverage.
